ex.en: Somehow she contrived to finish the report before the deadline.
ex.zh: 她不知怎么设法在截止前完成了报告。

words.note: 常接 to do，含费力设法之意；也可指策划、设计。

ex.en: The island has only a few hundred permanent inhabitants.
ex.zh: 这个岛只有几百名常住居民。

words.note: 由 inhabit 加 -ant 构成；搭配 inhabitant of。

ex.en: Only a small fraction of the students passed the final test.
ex.zh: 只有一小部分学生通过了期末考试。

words.note: 表小部分用 a fraction of；数学中表分数。

ex.en: He gave her flowers as a token of his appreciation.
ex.zh: 他送她鲜花以表谢意。

words.note: a token of sth 指…的象征；by the same token 表同理。

ex.en: She spoke with great emotion about her years in the village.
ex.zh: 她满怀感情地谈起在村里的那些年。

words.note: 可数不可数皆可；with emotion 指带着感情。

ex.en: The campaign attracted massive support from young voters.
ex.zh: 这项运动得到了年轻选民的大力支持。

words.note: 语气比 big 强，表巨大；副词 massively。

ex.en: Officials are still trying to assess the damage caused by the flood.
ex.zh: 官员们仍在设法评估洪水造成的损失。

words.note: 名词 assessment；强调评估价值或程度。

ex.en: At the school party the students mingle with guests from several countries.
ex.zh: 在学校聚会上，学生们与几个国家的宾客交谈。

words.note: 常与 with 连用，指混合或与人交往。

ex.en: The doctor wrote out a prescription for painkillers.
ex.zh: 医生开了一张止痛药处方。

words.note: 动词 prescribe 指开药；prescription drugs 指处方药。

ex.en: Thousands of spectators watched the race from the side of the road.
ex.zh: 数千名观众在路边观看比赛。

words.note: 指看比赛的观众；spectator sport 指观赏性运动。

ex.en: Not all the berries in the forest are edible, so be careful.
ex.zh: 森林里并非所有浆果都能吃，所以要小心。

words.note: 反义 inedible；只表能吃，不表好吃。

ex.en: Children are more prone to colds in winter than in summer.
ex.zh: 孩子在冬天比夏天更容易感冒。

words.note: be prone to sth；另义俯卧的，如 lie prone。

ex.en: The whole class answered in chorus when the teacher asked.
ex.zh: 老师提问时全班齐声回答。

words.note: in chorus 表齐声；指副歌也用 chorus。

ex.en: I owe my success to the support of my family.
ex.zh: 我把成功归功于家人的支持。

words.note: owe sth to sb；既指欠钱也指归功于。

ex.en: Her experience abroad is a valuable asset to the company.
ex.zh: 她的海外经验是公司的宝贵财富。

words.note: 多用于褒义，指有价值的人或物；fixed assets。

phr.en: a clear exposition of the theory

ex.en: The book opens with a clear exposition of the main theory.
ex.zh: 这本书开头清晰地阐述了主要理论。

words.note: 指详细阐述；也可指博览会，如 world exposition。

ex.en: The company raised the minimum wage for new workers.
ex.zh: 公司提高了新员工的最低工资。

words.note: 反义 maximum；keep to a minimum 表尽量减少。

ex.en: He made a public apology for his rude remarks.
ex.zh: 他为自己粗鲁的言论公开道歉。

words.note: 动词 apologise；apology for sth 指为某事道歉。

ex.en: The survey revealed that most workers were unhappy with their pay.
ex.zh: 调查显示大多数工人对自己的工资不满。

words.note: 可接 that 从句；名词 revelation 指揭露。

ex.en: The room was small but adequate for a short stay.
ex.zh: 房间不大，但短暂停留足够用了。

words.note: 表足够、可胜任，比 enough 正式。

ex.en: He is a night owl and rarely goes to bed before two.
ex.zh: 他是个夜猫子，很少两点前睡觉。

words.note: night owl 指熬夜的人；猫头鹰在西方象征智慧。

ex.en: He pulled the cork out of the bottle and poured the wine.
ex.zh: 他拔出瓶塞，倒出葡萄酒。

words.note: 指软木或瓶塞；作动词指用瓶塞塞住。

ex.en: The team worked under tremendous pressure to meet the deadline.
ex.zh: 团队在巨大压力下工作以按时完成。

words.note: 语气比 great 强；副词 tremendously。

ex.en: Working from home has become the norm in many companies.
ex.zh: 居家办公在许多公司已成为常态。

words.note: 表常态常用 the norm；复数 norms 指规范。

ex.en: She managed to condense the whole report into two pages.
ex.zh: 她成功地把整份报告压缩成了两页。

words.note: 指压缩文字或使冷凝；condensed milk 是炼乳。

ex.en: The report gave fresh impetus to the debate on climate policy.
ex.zh: 这份报告为气候政策辩论注入了新动力。

words.note: 常用 give impetus to sth，或 the impetus for。

ex.en: The decision to close the library caused great indignation among residents.
ex.zh: 关闭图书馆的决定引起了居民的极大愤慨。

words.note: 比 anger 正式，指因不公而生的义愤。

ex.en: Language can be a serious barrier to communication at work.
ex.zh: 在工作中，语言可能成为沟通的严重障碍。

words.note: 搭配 barrier to sth；break down barriers 指消除隔阂。

ex.en: We need to set realistic goals for the coming year.
ex.zh: 我们需要为来年设定现实可行的目标。

words.note: 指现实可行或逼真；反义 unrealistic。

ex.en: The police diverted traffic away from the flooded road.
ex.zh: 警察把车辆从被淹的道路上引开。

words.note: 指改道或转移注意力；divert attention from。
